name: Permanent Residence Permit

requirements.blocker_text: 7 years of legitimate/legal residence in Belarus (Law on Legal Status of Foreign Citizens, Article 50).

requirement_groups.name: Spouse or close relative of a Belarusian citizen

requirements.blocker_text: Spouses and close relatives of Belarusian citizens, and persons with family-reunification rights, may qualify for permanent residence without necessarily completing the full 7-year standard track -- exact reduced timeframe not stated as a precise figure in the source excerpt.

evidence_required.document: Proof of residence period or qualifying family tie

outcome.duration_length: indefinite; holder must remain in-country at least 183 days/year or the permit may be annulled

sources.title: LegislationLine -- Law on Legal Status of Foreign Citizens and Persons without Citizenship in the Republic of Belarus, Article 50: 7-year standard residence route to permanent residence, plus reduced-condition routes for spouses/relatives of citizens, refugees, and investors (EUR 150,000+, see by_investor_residence.json)

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Belarus). The 183-day/year physical-presence requirement to AVOID annulment is a genuinely distinctive and strict condition -- most 'permanent' residence statuses in this dataset carry no ongoing presence requirement once granted; Belarus's does. Termination/annulment grounds also include acquiring citizenship elsewhere, consistent with the country's general single-citizenship stance (see by_naturalisation.json).
